Key usability and possession are checked during the connection test. Public details remain on this screen and are not logged.

None is the default. mTLS proves possession of a per-device private key from Android KeyChain; the key is never exported. User selection is for pilots; MDM grants a managed alias for unattended delivery. Server trust is independent of the client certificate. A Wi-Fi credential is usable only if its purpose and application key access allow it. Key failure never falls back to None/HTTP. Local monitoring continues, and the queue remains bounded. Certificate checks do not affect Performance State.

Saving a different authentication mode, key alias or server trust clears pending uploads and cancels current requests. Local history stays available. Renewing a certificate under the same alias does not clear the queue.
